
Qwen3.6 35B-A3B on what-if: 8-core x86 CPU (CPU only), 32 GB RAM
Scenario: Claude Code — 20k-token system prompt + tools, then ~2.5k new tokens and ~300 output tokens per turn

RUNTIME                                  FILE            CONTEXT  MEMORY        FIRST REPLY  FOLLOW-UP  WRITES AT           TASK*
Ollama (defaults)                        Q4_K_M 22.1 GB  4k ⚠     ~ 21.3/22 GB  3 min 54 s   58 s       ~11 tok/s at 22.6k  ✗ breaks
Ollama (tuned)                           Q4_K_M 22.1 GB  56k      ✗ 22.4/22 GB  —            —          —                   —
llama.cpp (llama-server) (defaults)      Q4_K_M 22.1 GB  4k ⚠     ~ 21.3/22 GB  3 min 47 s   56 s       ~11 tok/s at 22.6k  ✗ breaks
llama.cpp (llama-server) (tuned)         Q4_K_M 22.1 GB  56k      ✗ 22.4/22 GB  —            —          —                   —
LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (defaults)  Q4_K_M 22.1 GB  4k ⚠     ~ 21.5/22 GB  3 min 49 s   57 s       ~11 tok/s at 22.6k  ✗ breaks
LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (tuned)     Q4_K_M 22.1 GB  56k      ✗ 22.4/22 GB  —            —          —                   —

FIRST REPLY = cold start (model load + the whole prompt). FOLLOW-UP = a typical later turn (new tokens only + the reply).
* TASK = a 40-call agent task; at datacenter speed it would take about 2 min 00 s. "✗ breaks" = the harness prompt does not fit the context.
Typical error (about 3 in 4 predictions): generation ±75%, prompt processing ±80%. CPU-only depends on memory configuration and threads; hybrid linear-attention model: little benchmark data for its recurrent layers.

  · CPU-only: memory bandwidth assumed; run `trialm detect --probe` to measure it

  ⚠ Ollama (defaults): Claude Code's ~20k-token prompt does not fit the 4096-token context (Ollama default for 22 GiB of GPU memory): the prompt is silently truncated and the agent will misbehave
  ⚠ Ollama (defaults): memory is tight: other apps or a longer context may push it over
  ⚠ quality caveat: the trial uses the cloud's provider-dependent weights; local Q4_K_M is typically 0–3 points worse on coding tasks and makes more tool-call mistakes
  ⚠ Ollama (tuned): does not fit: needs 22.4 GB, 22.0 GB available
  ⚠ llama.cpp (llama-server) (defaults): Claude Code's ~20k-token prompt does not fit the 4096-token context (model native context, reduced to fit free memory): requests will be rejected with a context error
  ⚠ llama.cpp (llama-server) (defaults): memory is tight: other apps or a longer context may push it over
  ⚠ llama.cpp (llama-server) (tuned): does not fit: needs 22.4 GB, 22.0 GB available
  ⚠ LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (defaults): Claude Code's ~20k-token prompt does not fit the 4096-token context (LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) default load setting): the middle of the conversation is silently cut
  ⚠ LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (defaults): memory is tight: other apps or a longer context may push it over
  ⚠ LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (tuned): does not fit: needs 22.4 GB, 22.0 GB available

Recommendation: no runtime gives a working Claude Code setup for this model here — try a smaller quant (--quant), a smaller model, or --ctx.
